# Vendored testlib

Source: https://github.com/MikeMirzayanov/testlib

Pinned commit: `1e4e8a24c79c6bad3becbdb5a332ffc352b7d5dd`.
Retrieved on 2026-10-01. `testlib.h`, `LICENSE`, and `checkers/*.cpp`
retain the upstream source and notices. Line endings are normalized to LF;
trailing spaces/tabs in `testlib.h` are removed for clean staged whitespace
checks. No source tokens, checker behavior, or license text are changed.
MiniOJ uses the default Linux testlib exit codes, not scoring or interaction.
No network download is performed during import or judging.
